suggestions.title: Ex Machina
suggestions.description: Caleb, a young coder at a tech giant, wins a week at his reclusive CEO's remote estate — where he's asked to administer a Turing test to Ava, a breathtakingly lifelike A.I. Alex Garland's debut is a sleek, unnerving chamber piece about consciousness, desire, and control, capped by one of the great endings in modern sci-fi. Oscar Isaac and Alicia Vikander are electric in a film that only gets sharper with every rewatch.

suggestions.title: Run Lola Run
suggestions.description: Lola has exactly twenty minutes to find 100,000 Deutschmarks and save her boyfriend's life — and the film plays the same frantic race three times, each with wildly different outcomes. Tom Tykwer's kinetic German cult classic is part thriller, part music video, part philosophy, all driven by Franka Potente's blazing central performance. A shot of pure cinematic adrenaline that invented a style all its own.

suggestions.title: Superbad
suggestions.description: Two inseparable high-school seniors, desperate to make the most of their last party before graduation, drag their geeky friend McLovin along for one gloriously chaotic night. Seth Rogen and Evan Goldberg's script and Jonah Hill and Michael Cera's chemistry turned a raunchy teen comedy into a surprisingly tender ode to friendship. Produced by Judd Apatow — endlessly quotable, and funnier every time you watch it.
